rounds.response: I propose structuring the first phase around three integrated strands — (A) Conceptual Frameworks: develop rigorous, testable framings of long-term capabilities, failure modes, and alignment desiderata; (B) Empirical Evaluation: run targeted experiments and stress-tests of large-model behavior to ground and falsify conceptual claims; and (C) Policy & Strategy Translation: turn emerging insights into decision-relevant scenarios, uncertainty assessments, and actionable guidance for policymakers. Over the first 12 months we should (1) produce a shared taxonomy and prioritized 5–10 year research questions (Conceptual), (2) execute 3 empirical pilot studies using the institute cluster plus an open benchmark suite (Empirical), and (3) draft 4 policy vignettes and a template for communicating uncertainty to decision-makers (Policy).
